definitions.gloss: fatality rate; death rate among those affected
definitions.explanation: The proportion of people who die among those who catch a disease or suffer a particular injury. A medical and public-health term, common in news about epidemics.

examples.japanese: この{病気|びょうき}は{致死率|ちしりつ}が{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: This disease has a low fatality rate.

examples.japanese: {治療法|ちりょうほう}の{進歩|しんぽ}で{致死率|ちしりつ}が{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: Advances in treatment have brought the fatality rate down.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{致死率|ちしりつ}が{若年層|じゃくねんそう}より{高|たか}いことが{調査|ちょうさ}で{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: The survey showed that the fatality rate among the elderly is higher than among younger people.

notes:
{致死|ちし} (causing death) + {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). Counts deaths only among people who actually contracted the disease, which is why the figure is often much larger than a mortality rate for the whole population.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {致死率|ちしりつ}が{高|たか}い: to have a high fatality rate
- {致死率|ちしりつ}を{下|さ}げる: to lower the fatality rate
- {致死率|ちしりつ}{一|いち}パーセント: a fatality rate of one percent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {死亡率|しぼうりつ}: mortality rate — deaths measured against a whole population
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}: infection rate — how many people catch the disease, not how many die
